maria: PTAL — addressed your infra config comments. Split the original test into unit + e2e, added a small smoke script under ./smoke/run_smoke.sh, and updated the README with tolerations and featureflag notes.

toni: quick q — is the feature flag off by default? and can you add the k8s toleration snippet we discussed?

maria: yep flag is off by default. Added toleration snippet in README and pushed a follow-up commit (force-pushed small rebase).

build-bot: CI queued — running pipeline (unit/e2e/lint).

build-bot: ✅ All checks passed (unit + e2e + lint) — 1749998899.

sam: LGTM from my side. small nit: logs formatting could be clearer but that's not blocking.

toni: +1. One ask: can you put the smoke command and minimal expected output in the PR description so ops can run it without digging?

maria: done — PR description updated with smoke usage and expected success lines. Also added a tiny retry for the flaky setup step. Can someone give final approval so I can merge before tomorrow's canary slot?

alex: Approved. :shipit:

maria: Thanks! I'll merge during the canary window and post a rollout note in #eng-oncall. Quick smoke commands are below for anyone who wants to run manually:

```
# from repo root - quick smoke (staging cluster)
./smoke/run_smoke.sh --target staging --quick
# local python runner
python -m smoke.runner --env staging --smoke-only
```

maria: tagging changelog and release note now. If anything pops in canary I'll rollback and ping here.
